Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Does the +1 intercept last as long as the card is on the vampire?

Eyes of the Beast
Type: Reaction
Requires: Protean
[pro] +1 intercept, and put this card on this reacting vampire. This
vampire gets -1 stealth. Burn this card during your next discard
phase.
[PRO] As above, with an optional maneuver during the first round of
the resulting combat if this vampire successfully blocks.

Rarity: KoT:C
